query:
-- Check Friday (03/27), Saturday (03/28), Sunday (03/29) tasks
SELECT 
  id, 
  title, 
  category, 
  DATE(dueDate) as due_date,
  `order`, 
  completed 
FROM tasks 
WHERE category = 'work' 
  AND DATE(dueDate) IN ('2026-03-27', '2026-03-28', '2026-03-29')
ORDER BY DATE(dueDate), `order`, id;
